name: image-regions
description: A photo (or a page placeholder) with rectangles over the parts that need the reader's eye, e.g. where text recognition was unsure (uncertain) or where a correction was taken (accepted).

props.name: src
props.description: Image URL (through safe_url). None: the page placeholder.

props.name: regions
props.description: List of {x, y, w, h, kind, label}: position and size in percent of the image, kind uncertain | accepted, label an accessible description (none: decorative).

rationale: From the application design canvas (2026-10-23), no Figma node. The rectangles use the same signal pairs as inline-mark's states in the text beside the photo (uncertain: the for-review row-status edge and fill; accepted: the approved row-status edge, no fill, so the text under it stays readable; both themed, unlike the signal-* primitives), so photo and text point at each other. Edge width border-width-default so the frame reads at a glance over a busy photo. The placeholder (grey lines on bg-surface-pressed, 440px high -- the canvas's portrait page) stands in while no image is shown; the canvas used the base-50 primitive, which has no themed token, replaced by bg-surface-pressed. Positions are host data in data-* attributes, applied as private custom properties by component.js, so no style value comes from the host. Rendering verified in light and dark themes.
a11y_notes: With an image, alt describes it; without, the frame is role=img with label. Each labelled region is role=img with its own name; unlabelled regions are aria-hidden.
